facts.statement: Free Realms joined an SOE fundraiser in which players could buy Cherry Blossom items, with SOE donating $10 per item sold to the American Red Cross.
facts.quote: From Friday, March 25th through Monday, March 28th, our players will be invited to purchase specially created Cherry Blossom items

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Support the Japan Earthquake & Tsunami Relief Effort)
article_summaries.summary: An SOE news post announcing a fundraiser after the 2011 Japan earthquake and tsunami. Free Realms took part by selling a Cherry Blossom Tree for 500 Station Cash and by offering Cherry Blossom items in the in-game marketplace from March 25 to March 28, with SOE donating $10 per item sold to the American Red Cross. The post is a capture of a page dated about one week before the 2011-04-02 capture; the exact posting date is not shown.
